item.title: Whataburger works with Lainey Wilson to announce FREE food giveaway on Wednesday
item.description: Whataburger is offering one of its most popular items for free on Wednesday, and they have collaborated with country music star Lainey Wilson to help get the word out.

item.title: All-Star infielder Isaac Paredes and Houston Astros agree to $9.35 million, 1-year contract
item.description: All-Star infielder Isaac Paredes and the Houston Astros avoided a salary arbitration hearing, agreeing Tuesday to a $9.35 million, one-year contract.

item.title: Man charged in deadly pedestrian crash in East Downtown, HPD says
item.description: A man was arrested and charged in connection with a fatal crash in the East Downtown area of Houston on Sunday night, police said.

item.title: Houston ISD mom demands answers after 4-year-old mistakenly put in wrong car
item.description: A Houston mother is outraged after her 4-year-old daughter was mistakenly placed in another person's car during after-school pickup at Bastian Elementary School, leaving her concerned about pickup protocols and calling for tighter safeguards to be put in place.

item.title: Sheriff says they're 'aware' of reported 'ransom note' related to Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Nancy, 84, was last seen on Saturday night at her Tucson, Arizona, home, where she lived alone.

item.title: Woman dead, man critically hurt after shooting in northeast Harris County, HCSO says
item.description: A woman is dead and a man is critically injured in what investigators say was an attempted murder-suicide in northeast Harris County.

item.title: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang on AI, robots and jobs
item.description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang says AI-powered robots are already everywhere and could help small manufacturers grow without replacing jobs.

item.title: Why NASA hit pause on Artemis II after fueling the Moon rocket at the launch pad
item.description: NASA says it’s one step closer to launching Artemis II after completing a major fueling test at Kennedy Space Center. Engineers worked through challenges, gathered key data, and are now eyeing March as the earliest possible launch window for the Moon-bound mission.

item.title: Maine plane crash victims worked for luxury travel startup led by Houston lawyer
item.description: The plane was flying from Houston to France when it stopped in Maine to refuel, when the Bombardier Challenger 600 crashed as a snowstorm moved in and burst into flames.

item.title: Severe thunderstorms rumble through Liberty, Montgomery counties
item.description: SE Texas will experience a freezing morning with temperatures in the 20s, but will rebound to the 50s with sunshine on Sunday, and the upcoming week will see temperatures flirting with the 70s with a few chances for rain.
